help.description: Verify, pin and install agent skills that MCP servers serve through the Skills Extension (SEP-2640) into Claude Code and Codex skill folders.
help.epilog: Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 changes found (check/verify), 2 usage or config error, 3 verification failed, 4 grant required, 5 connection or protocol error. Try: mcp-skillpin demo
help.lang: UI language: en or ko (default: from MCP_SKILLPIN_LANG, LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES, LANG)
help.json: print machine-readable JSON instead of text
help.servers: list MCP servers found in Claude Code and Codex config files
help.probe: connect to each server and report whether it serves skills
help.list: list the skills a server serves
help.add: verify a skill and (with --yes) install and pin it; dry run by default
help.target: claude, claude-user, codex, codex-user, or a folder path
help.yes: approve: write the verified files and update the lock file
help.grant: allow a frontmatter key that widens the skill's powers (repeatable)
help.check: compare pinned skills with what the servers serve now (exit 1 if changed)
help.update: show what changed for pinned skills; with --yes re-approve and install
help.verify: re-hash installed skill folders and compare with the lock file
help.demo: run the whole flow against a practice mock server in a temp folder
col.label: LABEL
col.name: NAME
list.title: Skills served by '{server}' ({count}):
add.dry_run: Dry run: nothing was written. Re-run with --yes to install.
check.missing: {name} MISSING (the server no longer serves it)
update.no_old: note: the installed copy of {path} no longer matches the lock, so no diff is shown for it
update.dry_run: Dry run: nothing was changed. Review the diff and risks above, then re-run with --yes to approve.
risk.nested-skill: RISK: nested SKILL.md {path} (needs its own approval before use)
risk.grant-key: RISK: frontmatter key '{path}' added or changed
demo.banner: This uses a practice mock MCP server (not a real service). It speaks the real protocol, so the client code really connects, verifies and installs.
demo.s1: 1. Find servers in the existing MCP config and probe them
demo.s3: 3. Dry run: nothing is written without --yes
demo.s4: 4. Approve: install release-notes and pin it
demo.switch: The server now publishes version 2 of release-notes (one added line in SKILL.md and a new scripts/collect.sh).
demo.s6: 6. A CI check notices the silent change
demo.s7: 7. Review the diff and the risk warning
demo.s9: 9. The lock file matches the server again
demo.s10: 10. A server whose digests lie: fail closed
demo.nothing_written: Nothing was written to the target folder.
demo.done: Done. Point it at your real servers with: mcp-skillpin servers
hint.legacy-protocol: hint: this server only speaks an older MCP protocol. Skills over MCP needs a server that supports {version}.
hint.grant-required: hint: read the skill first, then re-run with --grant <key> to allow it.
hint.local-collision: hint: a folder with this name already exists and is not managed by the lock file. Move it away or pick another --target.
hint.no-servers: hint: add the server to .mcp.json, ~/.claude.json or ~/.codex/config.toml.
hint.timeout: hint: raise the limit with --timeout SECONDS; remote servers can be slow.
hint.unsupported-transport: hint: only stdio and Streamable HTTP servers are supported in this version.
err.digest-mismatch: {uri} does not match the digest the server listed (expected {expected}, got {actual}). Nothing was written.
err.size-mismatch: {uri} has {actual} bytes but the server listed {expected}. Nothing was written.
err.unlisted-resource: the server returned {uri}, which skill '{skill}' does not list. Nothing was written.
err.frontmatter-mismatch: SKILL.md does not match the entry the server listed: {detail}.
err.name-mismatch: frontmatter name '{actual}' does not equal the last URI segment '{expected}' ({uri}).
err.dynamic-refused: {uri} is a dynamic skill: its content cannot be verified or pinned.
err.legacy-protocol: this server does not support protocol {version} (server/discover failed).
err.no-skills-extension: the server does not declare the {ext} extension.
err.local-collision: {path} already exists and is not pinned by this lock file. Existing files were left untouched.
err.server-not-found: no MCP server named '{name}'. Known servers: {known}.
err.server-ambiguous: '{name}' exists for more than one agent. Use one of: {labels}.
err.no-servers: no MCP servers found in .mcp.json, ~/.claude.json or ~/.codex/config.toml (looked from {cwd}).
help.help: show this help message and exit
help.discard_local: with --yes: overwrite local edits in the installed folder
update.local_edits: warning: the installed folder was edited locally; installing or updating replaces it. Files: {files}
err.target-changed: {path} already holds a pinned copy of this skill. Installing it elsewhere would leave that copy unpinned.
hint.target-changed: hint: remove that folder first, or keep using the same --target.
err.local-edits: the installed copy of '{name}' has local edits ({files}); installing or updating would overwrite them.
hint.local-edits: hint: save your edits elsewhere, then re-run with --yes --discard-local.
err.path-collision: {path} collides with {other}: the names differ only in letter case or Unicode form, so macOS and Windows would store them as one path. Nothing was written.
err.path-file-dir: {path} is listed as a file, but {other} needs a folder at the same path, and one path cannot be both (names are compared ignoring letter case and Unicode form, as macOS and Windows do). Nothing was written.
err.path-reserved: {path} uses the name {other}, which mcp-skillpin keeps for its own origin record. Nothing was written.
err.path-on-disk: {path} cannot be written as its own file: another file or folder of this skill already takes that path on this disk. Nothing was installed.
hint.unsafe-path: hint: nothing was written. The server's file list cannot be installed safely as it is; send the message above to the server owner.
hint.path-collision: hint: ask the server owner to rename one of the two so they differ by more than letter case or Unicode form.
hint.path-file-dir: hint: ask the server owner to rename the file or the folder.
hint.usage: hint: run '{prog} --help' to see every argument and option.
hint.io-error: hint: check that the folder exists and that you may write to it (permissions, free space), then try again.
usage.invalid_choice_closest: invalid choice: {value}, maybe you meant {closest}? (choose from {choices})
